row: Institute for Massage and Bodywork Therapy

Welcome to the Institute for Massage and Bodywork Therapy. On our channel you will find videos that answer several of the most asked questions we hear about the industry and what we do.

Our goal is to introduce you to the IMBT in a way that illustrates if our school won't be or will be a good fit for you. Our mission is to help you achieve your goal of becoming a competent massage therapist. 

Of course if we don't touch on your specific question (see what we did there?), feel free to visit our website, imbtnc.com and schedule a call or drop us an email. We're interested in your journey! Oh yeah, and if you like what you hear, hit the like button and subscribe. K?
